figures.caption: Figure 2: The overall workflow of LookME. External embedding tables are separately stored in ROM from the main backbone. LookME layers are inserted into the decoder, where consecutive layers communicate and share embedding tables via sparse intra-layer propagation. Each LookME layer includes an SKA gate for sparse inter-layer activation and three parallel lookup pathways to retrieve embeddings for enhancement.
Table 1: Comparison with SOTA methods. The best results are in bold and the second best are underlined. All models are evaluated under the same zero-shot settings.
